traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: The mind meets disruption and originality. Fast, unconventional, leap-of-insight thinking that resists linear order. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Brilliant, inventive insight and quick grasp of new systems and technology. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize thinking and disruption into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what thinking and disruption have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Strong for innovation, problem-solving, and tech; weak for routine detail and steady communication.
shadow: The ease lets scattered overthinking and instability for its own sake go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.
base: A clever shortcut or unexpected suggestion can solve a problem that has been approached the same way for too long.

readerCopy.body: A clever shortcut or unexpected suggestion can solve a problem that has been approached the same way for too long. When Mercury sextiles Uranus, thought and experimentation cooperate, making unusual ideas easier to test without requiring everything that already works to be discarded. A different tool, question, or order of operations can expose how much of the friction belonged to the method. The new approach earns its place by removing the bottleneck, not by being novel.
